Enum Class DateTimePrecision

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<DateTimePrecision>
network.ike.foundation.ike.elm.DateTimePrecision
All Implemented Interfaces:
dev.ikm.tinkar.common.bind.ClassConceptBinding, dev.ikm.tinkar.common.bind.EnumConceptBinding, Serializable, Comparable<DateTimePrecision>, Constable
public enum DateTimePrecision extends Enum<DateTimePrecision> implements dev.ikm.tinkar.common.bind.EnumConceptBinding
The ELM date time precision: how fine a date or time comparison is. One constant per value concept of the catalog's enumeration ELM DateTimePrecision, each carrying that concept's public id. Hand-written to the shape the bindings goal will emit (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1111).
